title: Three Years and One Short Tool
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：suggestion　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 suggestion 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the craftsman ① made the suggestion that no apprentice in the workshop would have described, and he said the making was the whole of the year. The ② suggestion, meaning the idea itself and not the tool, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a suggestion, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ suggestion in that workshop had the same short tool beside it, and the ④ suggestion at the far bench, meaning the order they kept for the children to finish and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A suggestion, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the craftsman said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the suggestion was the whole of the matter, meaning the wisdom and not the idea. The ⑥ suggestion, meaning the wisdom and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; suggestion, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both an idea and a wisdom. He said the wisdom is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ suggestion had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short tool. The ⑧ suggestion of the whole thing, the craftsman wrote in August, was one workshop and three years of describing; suggestion, he said, is either the order at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ suggestion I remember is the idea described in the ledger, which closed in 1967 and is still described as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ suggestion, my mother said in 1969, is the only idea that improves by being described; every suggestion, she said, is a wisdom that has agreed to look like an idea. She said the wisdom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 建议（指工坊里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 建议（指那条建议本身，与小小的工具相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the suggestion 提出这一条建议
D. n. 建议（指留给孩子们赶完的那一桩）
E. n. 建议之事（抽象总称，指一处工坊的建议之事）
F. n. 建议（指工料簿里写到、被描述的那一条）
G. n. 建议、见识（指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: make the suggestion 意为“提出这一条建议”，1960 年那位匠人把工坊里没有一位学徒肯描述的一条建议做了一遍。
suggestion 意为“建议”，指那条建议本身而不是小小的工具，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被描述。
suggestion 意为“建议”，指工坊里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一件小小的工具。
suggestion 意为“建议”，指最远那张案台的留给孩子们赶完的那一桩，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
suggestion 意为“建议、见识”，指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条见识就是那件事的全部。
suggestion 意为“见识”，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条建议，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
suggestion 意为“建议”，指工料簿里写到、被描述的那一条，到 1965 年这一条成了工料簿里的一行。
suggestion 意为“建议之事”，匠人八月写道，整件事的建议之事是一处工坊和三个年头的描述。
suggestion 意为“建议”，我记得的是工料簿里描述过的那一条，1967 年出师了，至今仍被说成工坊里最安静的一条。
suggestion 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，建议是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的建议。
